info.title: Reverde | Fire Incidents
info.description:
Fire incident records, verification status, and damage assessments.

Current implementation: service connectivity only. Domain CRUD, persistence, and authentication are planned and are not exposed by this API yet. Use the centralized gateway Swagger UI to call this service through discovery and load balancing.

tags.name: Service connectivity
tags.description: Confirm gateway routing and identify the responding instance.

get.summary: Identify a running Fire Incidents instance
get.description: Returns this instance's identity, actual listening port, and current UTC time. Repeated gateway requests may reach different instances. This endpoint does not return business records.

port.description: Actual instance port; changes when scaling locally.

ServiceIdentity.description: Identity of the instance that answered the request.
